div.head: III Eg 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ æt nanum botwyrðum gylte ne forwyrce man mare þane his wer.
⁊ æt nannum botwyrðum gylte ne forwyrce mon mare þonne his wer.
Et de nulla emendabili re forisfaciat homo plus quam weram suam.
⁊ æt nanum botwyrðum gilte ne forwyrce man mare þonne his wer.
And no man shall forfeit more than his wergeld for any offence for which compensation may be paid.
In crimes that admit of compensation, no one is to forfeit more than his wergild.
Und bei keiner [durch Geld] büssbaren Schuld verwirke jemand mehr als sein eigenes Wergeld.
And for no offence that can be compensated [with money] let anyone forfeit more than his own wergild.
